diagrams.title: New STRIDE diagram

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: An attacker obtains customer's credentials and takes control of phone
threats.mitigation: P1 should verify credentials and require 2FA for sensitive actions

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: An attacker who compromises P2 or alters the data in transit could change the transaction amount or destination, or manipulate the balances
threats.mitigation: Validate transaction details before committing them

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: An attacker floods P2 with repeated transaction requests overwhelming it
threats.mitigation: Apply per account and per source rate limiting

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: An agent exploits a flaw in P2’s authorization checks to perform an action reserved for a customer or a higher privileged role
threats.mitigation: Enforce role- and account-based authorization in P2 for every transaction, using trusted permissions from D1

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: A customer or an agent denying a transaction that is recorded in D2 wallet
threats.mitigation: Having isolated audits with comprehensive data such as timestamps, amount and type of transaction

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Obtaining customer financial data as it flows from D2 to P2
threats.mitigation: Enforcing permissions and returning info only authenticated agent and customer can view

diagrams.description: PesaPoa is a fictional Tanzanian mobile-money platform that lets customers transfer funds and lets agents process deposits and withdrawals. It uses customer accounts, wallet balances, and transaction records. SMS is used for authentication or account recovery
